identity.name: Mistral7B-PairRM-SPPO-Iter1
identity.summary: A language model aligned through Self-Play Preference Optimization at iteration 1, starting from the Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 architecture.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: Fine-tuned on synthetic datasets from UltraFeedback prompts; synthetic data can include hallucinations, and the card reports no evaluation of factual accuracy.

possible_risks.description: Applicable laws can establish data subject rights such as opt-out rights, right to access, and right to be forgotten. Synthetic data might raise unique concerns, such as the potential for reidentification of individuals from seemingly anonymous synthetic data. Data subject rights might also be relevant in scenarios where synthetic data is derived from sensitive or personal information.
possible_risks.justification: Trained on ~60k prompts from diverse resources via UltraFeedback and synthetic datasets, with no stated provenance/consent or de-identification measures, so data subject rights concerns are plausible.

possible_risks.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
possible_risks.justification: Card documents only architecture, training data split, and license; it lacks documentation of synthetic data design choices/verification, making accountability harder to establish.

specifications.model_size: 13.5 GiB of safetensors weights (14,483,498,016 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was developed using Self-Play Preference Optimization at iteration 1, starting from the mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 architecture. During fine-tuning, the dataset was split into three portions and only one portion was used per iteration, following the standard chat template of Mistral-7B.
training_context.training_data: The model was fine-tuned on synthetic datasets using prompt sets from the openbmb/UltraFeedback dataset, split into three parts for three iterations via snorkelai/Snorkel-Mistral-PairRM-DPO-Dataset. The prompts number around 60k and come from diverse resources.
